title: Check occupation tails before exchanging a Trotter and grand limit
statement: At every fixed L the positive-transfer Jensen/collision bound leaves a polynomial occupation tail, while the exact Gibbs tail is stretched exponential; L=1 has a divergent balanced critical grand trace. The stated log-partition tolerance forces Omega(sqrt(K)/log K) mesh growth. This is a necessary mesh condition, not a sufficient approximation theorem.
